Select all IC50 activity rows for human Pim-1 kinase. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs (via assays.doc_id), and compound_structures (inner join). Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (coalesce DOI and PMID), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all rows; do not deduplicate.
